resources.string:
This app turns off the system apps that receive wireless emergency alerts. While they are off, this device will not show any emergency alerts, including earthquake, tsunami and evacuation alerts.

Only use it on a device where you get these alerts some other way, such as a display or test device. You are responsible for turning alerts off and for anything that results from it.
